Class IuConfig

java.lang.Object
edu.iu.config.IuConfig
public class IuConfig extends Object
Secure configuration utility.

Configuration has a one-way lifecycle, and like a ModuleLayer.Controller, everything before sealing is the application's responsibility. IuConfig is embedded in the application and loaded by the application's own class loader; it doesn't synchronize setup.

  1. Register each configuration type, with registerInterface(String, Class, IuVault...) for a type stored in vault or registerFactory(Class, Function) for one created by the application.
  2. Optionally, customize how configuration binds.
  3. Call seal() once. Sealing is required and can't be undone: no type can be registered afterward, and no configuration can be loaded before.
  4. Load configuration by type and key.

The first three steps belong in one block, on one thread, early in application initialization, ending with seal() before the application creates thread pools or starts any thread that loads configuration. Thread.start() makes everything written before sealing visible to threads started afterward; setting up from more than one thread, or after such threads exist, isn't supported.

Stored configuration binds from JSON by the web crypto configuration, Init.jsonbConfig(): property names in snake_case, binary data in base64url, algorithms and encryptions by JOSE name, and crypt's conversions for keys and certificates; JSON-B's defaults apply otherwise, so dates are ISO-8601 and enums are by name. Beyond that configuration:

  • Wherever a type registered by registerInterface or registerFactory is bound, a JSON string refers to a value by key, loaded by load(Class, String). A factory type binds only from a key, or null.
  • Wherever an Iterable, Collection, List, or Set is bound, a value other than an array binds as a one-item container of that type.

IuConfig only reads configuration: load(Class, String) is the one operation it provides to consumers. jsonb() lets application code convert in the same JSON dialect. A tool that writes configuration may load through IuConfig, but saves values by its own logic, which is outside this module's scope.

configureJsonb(Consumer) is how the application changes how configuration binds; the configuration is fixed when sealed, and jsonb() then returns the Jsonb it binds with.

  • Method Details

    • registerFactory

      public static <T> void registerFactory(Class<T> configType, Function<String,T> load)
      Registers a factory method for a configuration type, caching what it creates for 15 seconds.

      Part of the application's setup; see the class documentation.

      Wherever the configuration type is bound, a JSON string is a key, loaded by load(Class, String) through the factory, and JSON null binds as null. Any other JSON value fails with JsonbException. A subtype registered in its own right, such as a configuration interface that extends the type, converts by its own registration instead. Writing the type is outside IuConfig's scope; an application that writes configuration may register its own serializer with configureJsonb(Consumer), for example writing the key. As with registerInterface, the order of this call relative to configureJsonb(Consumer) matters for components of the same type.

      Type Parameters:
      T - configuration type
      Parameters:
      configType - configuration type
      load - factory method handle; creates the configuration for a key
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if sealed
      IllegalArgumentException - if configType is already registered
      NullPointerException - if load is null
      See Also:
      • registerFactory(Class, Function, Duration)

    • registerFactory

      public static <T> void registerFactory(Class<T> configType, Function<String,T> load, Duration cacheTtl)
      Registers a factory method for a configuration type.

      Part of the application's setup; see the class documentation.

      Wherever the configuration type is bound, a JSON string is a key, loaded by load(Class, String) through the factory, and JSON null binds as null. Any other JSON value fails with JsonbException. A subtype registered in its own right, such as a configuration interface that extends the type, converts by its own registration instead. Writing the type is outside IuConfig's scope; an application that writes configuration may register its own serializer with configureJsonb(Consumer), for example writing the key. As with registerInterface, the order of this call relative to configureJsonb(Consumer) matters for components of the same type.

      When concurrent callers request the same uncached key, the factory is invoked only once; callers that arrive while it is loading use the cached object once the load completes.

      Type Parameters:
      T - configuration type
      Parameters:
      configType - configuration type
      load - factory method handle; creates the configuration for a key
      cacheTtl - time period for caching config objects; null for 15 seconds
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if sealed
      IllegalArgumentException - if configType is already registered
      NullPointerException - if load is null

    • registerInterface

      public static <T> void registerInterface(String prefix, Class<T> configType, edu.iu.client.IuVault... vault)
      Registers a configuration type loaded from vault, caching what it loads for 15 seconds.

      Part of the application's setup; see the class documentation.

      Type Parameters:
      T - configuration type
      Parameters:
      prefix - prefix to append to vault key to classify the resource names used by load(Class, String); lowercase letters only
      configType - configuration type
      vault - vaults to load configuration from, in order
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if sealed
      IllegalArgumentException - if configType is already registered, prefix isn't lowercase letters, or vault is empty
      NullPointerException - if prefix or vault is null
      See Also:
      • registerInterface(String, Class, Duration, IuVault...)

    • registerInterface

      public static <T> void registerInterface(String prefix, Class<T> configType, Duration cacheTtl, edu.iu.client.IuVault... vault)
      Registers a configuration type loaded from vault.

      Part of the application's setup; see the class documentation.

      A key loads from the secret named by the prefix, a slash, and the key, from each vault in turn: the first that binds is cached and returned, and if none does, the first failure is thrown with the others suppressed.

      Wherever the configuration type is bound, a JSON string refers to a stored value by key, loaded by load(Class, String); any other value binds by the type's own conversion, which for a configuration interface reads a JSON object with snake_case property names.

      Type Parameters:
      T - configuration type
      Parameters:
      prefix - prefix to append to vault key to classify the resource names used by load(Class, String); lowercase letters only
      configType - configuration type
      cacheTtl - time period for caching config objects; null for 15 seconds
      vault - vaults to load configuration from, in order
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if sealed
      IllegalArgumentException - if configType is already registered, prefix isn't lowercase letters, or vault is empty
      NullPointerException - if prefix or vault is null

    • configureJsonb

      public static void configureJsonb(Consumer<JsonbConfig> configConsumer)
      Customizes how configuration binds, before sealing.

      Part of the application's setup; see the class documentation. configConsumer receives the live JsonbConfig and may add components or replace anything in it, including the defaults the class documentation describes. Components for the same type run in the order they were configured, so the order of this call relative to registerInterface matters. Changes made after seal() have no effect, so don't keep the reference.

      Parameters:
      configConsumer - accepts the in-progress JsonbConfig
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if sealed
      NullPointerException - if configConsumer is null

    • seal

      public static void seal()
      Seals configuration; required once, at the end of the application's setup.

      Fixes how configuration binds, from the JSON-B configuration accumulated by registration and configureJsonb(Consumer). Until sealed, nothing can be loaded; once sealed, no type can be registered. The application calls this before creating thread pools or starting any thread that loads configuration; see the class documentation.

      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if already sealed

    • load

      public static <T> T load(Class<T> configType, String key)
      Loads a configuration object, from its registered vaults or factory.

      A loaded object is cached by key for the time period registered with its type.

      Type Parameters:
      T - configuration type
      Parameters:
      configType - configuration type
      key - key
      Returns:
      loaded configuration
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if not sealed
      NullPointerException - if configType isn't registered
      RuntimeException - if no vault loads the key, as described for registerInterface(String, Class, Duration, IuVault...), or if the factory fails

    • jsonb

      public static Jsonb jsonb()
      Gets the Jsonb instance used to deserialize configuration documents loaded from Vault.

      The same instance load(Class, String) binds with, for conversions that need identical semantics. Where a type registered by registerInterface is bound, a JSON string resolves through load(Class, String), which may read from Vault.

      Returns:
      Jsonb
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if not sealed
